direction: Stagnation-adaptive destruction scoring: rank-power p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) that grows during stagnation (diversify) but shrinks near deadline (exploit), multiplied by capacity-tightness and depot-eccentricity gates to target the weakest regimes (capacity_level=tight, depot_style=eccentric, spatial=clustered).

operations.mechanism: Archive shows SBS at 15.788 mean objective (217.7 ms) and round-3 attempt at 16.074 regressed by +0.2856, so we must not just re-tune absolute savings ranking. Weakest regimes are capacity_level=tight (-23.4% rel gap), size=100, demand_dist=uniform, depot_style=eccentric, spatial=clustered — all indicative of route saturation and geometry rather than pure cost-greedy removal. KB method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 confirms the multiplicative gate + rank-power form (score_i = rank_power(|savings|/scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio))) is the verified evolvable hook with deterministic Regret-2 repair and R2R acceptance; it also notes stagnation-aware diversification is a strong-on regime. Stagnation-adaptive p exploits the anytime LNS budget (first feasible ~2-3 ms, so ~200+ ms of iterations remain within 500 ms) without extra per-iteration cost. Postprocess stays none since only that mode is allowed and the L3 skeleton's intra_2opt + Regret-2 already performs local repair.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: If score_ruin_nodes uses score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i|/scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist, p) with p rising from ~1.2 toward ~2.5 as stagnation_ratio grows but decaying as iter_frac -> 1, and gate_load = (route_load/capacity)^2 rewards over-full routes while gate_rdist = route_dists/mean_route_dist penalizes long routes, then mean objective on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 improves versus the current SBS (15.788 mean) because tight-capacity and clustered instances are best served by re-inserting customers out of saturated routes rather than the highest absolute-savings edges.
